```{r}
source("scripts/build_seminar_data.R")
```

This page provides individual session-level attendance maps and notes on country-data availability. The [programme overview](index.html) summarises cumulative reach and continued engagement across the series.

Attendance is deduplicated within each session, with known AI notetakers excluded. For recurring meetings, **registered by this session** is the cumulative number registered by the end of that session.

```{r}
#| results: asis

for (i in rev(seq_len(nrow(seminar_data)))) {
  seminar <- seminar_data[i, ]

  notes <- character()

  if (!seminar$country_collected) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste(
        "Country was not collected in this registration form.",
        "Country information could be matched for some attendees",
        "using registrations from other seminars."
      )
    )
  }

  note_text <- if (length(notes) > 0) {
    paste0(
      "\n\n",
      paste(notes, collapse = " "),
      "\n\n"
    )
  } else {
    "\n\n"
  }

  child_text <- paste0(
    "\n## ", seminar$seminar_display_title, "\n\n",
    format(seminar$file_date, "%d %B %Y"), "\n\n",
    "**Registered by this session:** ", seminar$total_registrants, "  \n",
    "**Attendees:** ", seminar$total_attendees, "  \n",
    "**Attendees with country information:** ",
    seminar$attendees_mapped, " of ", seminar$total_attendees,
    note_text,
    "### Attendees by country\n\n",
    "```{r seminar-", i, "-africa}\n",
    "seminar_data$map_africa[[", i, "]]\n",
    "```\n"
  )

  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      text = child_text,
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```
